title: Second Chance
description: This Plugin gives you second chance when you die!
body:
# 🛡️ Second Chance

**Have you ever died simply because you forgot to hold the Totem of Undying?**  
With this plugin, that will never happen again!  

Grant yourself a **second chance** by using a command or by right-clicking with the Totem in your hand.  
You will become immune to death **once per activation**:  
- Any fatal damage will instead leave you with **half a heart**  
- You will also receive **Absorption** and **Fire Resistance**  

✨ No more worrying about keeping the Totem in your off-hand!  

---

## 📌 Commands
- `/secondchance <true|false>` – View or set the current plugin state.  
- `/secondchancemessage [message]` – Set the message that appears when the second chance is triggered.  
- `/givesecondchance <player>` – Grant a second chance to yourself (if no player is specified) or to another player.
